## Category 1: Preview Component Reuse (3 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Preview uses LetterStoryReader (not LiveStoryCardExpanded)
**Given:** Sender has a doc with 2 stories
**When:** Sender navigates to `/letter/:docId/preview`
**Then:** Preview renders LetterStoryReader phase UI (position buttons, "Continue", "I've read this story") — NOT LiveStoryCardExpanded card
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — no `[data-testid="live-story-card-expanded"]` visible, phase buttons visible

### UAT-1.2: Preview has parchment background
**Given:** Sender is on preview page
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** Background matches reading page parchment (CertificatePageShell), not plain white
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — compare visually with reading page

### UAT-1.3: Preview ratings do not persist to DB
**Given:** Sender is on preview page, advances to rating phase
**When:** Sender clicks a rating value
**Then:** Rating is visually selected, but no `story_verifications` or `letter_point_responses` rows are created in DB
**Verify:** Check Supabase admin for new rows after interaction

---

## Category 2: Chrome-Free Layout (3 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Preview page has no top nav
**Given:** Sender navigates to `/letter/:docId/preview`
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** No ClarityPledge top navigation bar (Home, Letters, Events, My Profile) visible
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — top of page shows only preview banner

### UAT-2.2: Reading page has no top nav
**Given:** Receiver navigates to `/letter/:id?token=xxx`
**When:** Page loads (cover or reading view)
**Then:** No ClarityPledge top navigation bar visible — only FocusHeader or letter content
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — top of page shows only FocusHeader or cover

### UAT-2.3: Bottom nav still hidden on letter routes
**Given:** Logged-in user on preview or reading page
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** Bottom navigation bar is not visible (existing behavior preserved)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — bottom of page has no nav bar

---

## Category 3: Exit Actions (2 tests)

### UAT-3.1: "Back to composition" is a clickable action
**Given:** Sender is on preview page
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** "Back to composition" is a link or button (not plain text), clicking it returns to compose page
**Verify:** Playwright MCP click — navigates to `/letter/:docId/compose`

### UAT-3.2: End of preview has actionable return button
**Given:** Sender advances through all stories in preview
**When:** Last story is complete
**Then:** An actionable button/link returns to composition (not plain "End of preview" text)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP click — navigates back to compose
